mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CATEGORY ( CATEGORY_NAME, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, FIRST_REGISTER_DATE, FIRST_REGISTER_TIME, LAST_CHANGE_DATE, LAST_CHANGE_TIME ) VALUES ( COALESCE(#{categoryName}, ''), COALESCE(#{description}, ''), COALESCE(#{status}, '01'), #{firstRegisterDate}, #{firstRegisterTime}, #{lastChangeDate}, #{lastChangeTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID AS "categoryId" , CATEGORY_NAME AS "categoryName" , DESCRIPTION AS "description" , STATUS AS "status" , LAST_CHANGE_DATE AS "lastUpdate" FROM CATEGORY WHERE STATUS = '01' AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR CATEGORY_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' ) ORDER BY FIRST_REGISTER_DATE DESC, CATEGORY_ID ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM CATEGORY WHERE STATUS = '01' AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR CATEGORY_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' )
SELECT CATEGORY_ID AS "categoryId" , CATEGORY_NAME AS "categoryName" , DESCRIPTION AS "description" FROM CATEGORY WHERE STATUS = '01' ORDER BY FIRST_REGISTER_DATE DESC, CATEGORY_ID ASC LIMIT 6

SELECT CAT.CATEGORY_ID AS "categoryId" , CAT.CATEGORY_NAME AS "categoryName" , CAT.DESCRIPTION AS "description" , COUNT(DS.source_id ) AS "totalDataset" , CAT.LAST_CHANGE_DATE AS "lastChangeDate" FROM CATEGORY CAT LEFT JOIN DATASOURCE DS ON CAT.CATEGORY_ID = DS.CATEGORY_ID WHERE CAT.STATUS = '01' AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR CAT.CATEGORY_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR CAT.CATEGORY_ID::text ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' ) GROUP BY CAT.CATEGORY_ID,CAT.CATEGORY_ID,CAT.CATEGORY_NAME,CAT.DESCRIPTION,CAT.LAST_CHANGE_DATE,CAT.FIRST_REGISTER_DATE ORDER BY CAT.FIRST_REGISTER_DATE DESC, CAT.CATEGORY_ID ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM CATEGORY CAT LEFT JOIN DATASOURCE DS ON CAT.CATEGORY_ID = DS.CATEGORY_ID WHERE CAT.STATUS = '01' AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR CAT.CATEGORY_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR CAT.CATEGORY_ID::text ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' )
